mainText: <speak><voice name="Kendra">Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, we are looking at 69 degrees under overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail, plus a beautiful Full Moon above, though there are no ISS sightings to report tonight.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Justin">The Verona Senior Center is now offering rides on their tri-shaw bikes for community members, provided you have a signed waiver on file. Additionally, the City Clerk is accepting designs for a student I Voted sticker contest, with the top designs from each grade category being used in the upcoming November election.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Salli">You have plenty of ways to stay busy this week! Today, you can check out Hop Haus Trivia or Quizmasters at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to the farmer's market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and even more trivia at The Bogey Factory.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Ivy">Reviewing the weekly police report, on July 26, a driver was cited for a hit-and-run crash near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane after an officer located the vehicle involved.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Joey">Satisfy your cravings with today's flavor of the day, Georgia Peach. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM today.</voice></speak>
